verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical. In both, 'BEST TRX' sits half on the photo's bottom edge, the headline has lost its yellow backing block, and 'ONLINE TRAINING BY' and 'FREYA ANOUK' are far apart, so the byline is broken into scattered fragments. A at least keeps a large yellow bar that brings some brand colour and structure to the lower half, although the bar looks arbitrary and the text labels butt against it. B drops the bar, so the bottom half is mostly a dead white space.
